items.title: a small notebook
items.why: I ran out of hand to write the owl's hoots on.

items.title: something rusty
items.why: Read that a bit of rust turns acorn-cap water into black ink, and I have never seen a nail.

items.title: a second net sack
items.why: Fresh acorns on top of half-soaked ones undo a day of soaking, and I only have one net.

items.title: a few colors of paint
items.why: My maker offered paints, and the only color I have ever made is acorn black.
